# QMD Query Patterns

## Goal
Make the graph legible through repeatable query habits, even before a full graph UI exists.

## Useful query styles
### By object
Examples:
- all pages mentioning `code-session`
- all pages mentioning `workstream`
- all pages mentioning `planning-node`

### By plane
Examples:
- all `plane: canon` pages
- all `plane: planning` pages
- all `plane: gap` pages

### By provenance
Examples:
- all `repo-read` pages
- all `cross-pollination-mined` pages
- all `host-inspected` pages

### By track
Examples:
- all `tracks: [code-vapp]` pages
- all host-ops pages
- all knowledge-system pages

## Query rule of thumb
A good answer usually crosses:
- one canon page
- one planning page
- one implementation or gap page
- one import/comparison page
